grammar.summary: 本课学习表妥协的 agree to do 与条件谈判句式。

points.title: agree to do / agree to + 名词
points.explanation: agree to do sth. = 同意做某事；agree to the terms = 接受条件，to 后接名词/不定式有别于 agree with sb.。

examples.en: The busmen have agreed to return to work.

points.title: relieve 表缓解（复现）
points.explanation: to relieve the pressure = 缓解压力，relieve 的名词 relief（松了口气）。

examples.en: It will relieve the pressure on the trains.
